description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Accenture Federal Services is seeking a Junior Full Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications. The role focuses on REST API development and modern web technologies.
Full-stack application developer building and maintaining REST APIs and modern web applications

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications with a focus on REST API development and modern web technologies

Requirements:
• Backend: Java, JPA/ORM, REST API design & development, API security
• Database: PostgreSQL, SQL query syntax, relational database concepts
• Frontend: Angular or React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js
• Data Formats: XML, JSON System: Basic Unix/Linux commands, networking fundamentals
• Troubleshooting and debugging Java applications Others: Git, Gradle, Maven
• Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States

Preferred:
• Cloud: AWS services (S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, Cognito)
• Messaging: Kafka, AWS SQS Authentication: OAuth implementation DevOps: CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins)
• Languages: Scala, Python Emerging Tech: AI/ML integration
